title: European Crop Care Association (ECCA) v European Commission, C-773/23 P
issuing_body: Court of Justice of the European Union, First Chamber
holding_summary: A non-Member-State/non-institution intervener may appeal under Article 56 of the Statute only where the General Court decision directly affects its own legal situation; intervention interest alone is insufficient.
ECCA did not establish the required direct effect and its appeal was dismissed as inadmissible without adjudicating the substantive pesticide-regulatory grounds.
